note: On Hopeville Pond, an impoundment of the Pachaug River in Griswold; wooded sites on a peninsula with a swimming beach and a boat launch. Five sites (E10, E12, E14, E16, E18) are posted at 20 ft; the canoe-in sites are tent only. No pets or alcohol. --Claude
summary: ctparks + ReserveAmerica read: $17/$27, W&E $27/$37 confirmed; 80 sites, 11 W&E (50A at B01), 35 ft standard (five at 20 ft), 4 pull-throughs; showers, potable water, dump; 2026 season Apr 17-Oct 12 written; note cleaned. Waterfront lakefront looks too high (lakeview recommended); pin ~500 m off on the wrong side of the pond.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, recommend lakeview): the DEEP campground map puts every C-loop site (C1-C29, the pond side) INSIDE the loop road - the road runs between those sites and the west shore and the swimming beach. ReserveAmerica tags only E11, E13 and E15 'Near Water' (also the 4 tent-only canoe sites CN01-04). On imagery (Esri, 41.6003,-71.9268) E13/E15 at the south tip sit about 40-45 m from the water but under continuous tree cover (leaf-off pines and hardwoods), not open ground, so the ~50 m open-apron test is not met. Operator wording: 'heavily wooded setting near the pond ... Choose a campsite closest to the shoreline for a bonus pond view' (marketing, not a basis). Recommended: lakeview (C-loop and E11/E13/E15 look through trees across the road/slope); 'not waterfront' if the reviewer wants the strict reading.

PIN: stored 41.6050,-71.9305 lands in the woods on the WEST side of Hopeville Pond, about 500 m from the campground. The campground (bathhouse at ~41.6019,-71.9273; loops centred ~41.6015,-71.9269) is on the east-side peninsula. Recommend 41.6015,-71.9269.
PHONE: stored 860-376-2920 is the park office (ReserveAmerica). ctparks lists 'Campground Office: (860) 376-0313' - consider adding/replacing.

SITE LENGTHS: ReserveAmerica Max Vehicle Length 35 ft on every standard site except E10, E12, E14, E16, E18 (20 ft); about 70 RV-bookable sites take 23 ft+. 35 ft on almost every site may be a default value. Electric sites (10 on RA: B01, B03, B05, B07, B09, D02, D04, D08, F09, F10; DEEP says 11).
STATUS: ReserveAmerica shows the campground closed through Thu Apr 15 2027 (off season) - not a closure.
